reasoning: The upward arrow leaving a tray is the universal UI pictogram for uploading or exporting data. While it represents an action rather than a concrete physical object, uploading files to portals and exporting data are very common, self-contained digital tasks where the transfer action itself is the point of the task.

pass1.ambiguity: Easily confused with the iOS share icon or a generic cloud backup icon; inverse of the download icon.
